category_title: Youth with intellectual disabilities who thrive in hands-on retail environments
minimal_context: Eric is sitting in the classroom completing paperwork to prepare for an upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Eric, please sit down and start working on this paperwork to prepare for the upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do this. I like hands-on learning, not just sitting here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just focus on the worksheet in front of you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But school is just a place where we sit down and just do paperwork. It doesn't teach me any skills.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to know this information for the exam. Keep reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the paper away) No. I'm just going to learn this for your test and then forget about it. I want to do something real, like prepare for an interview.
